title: Tension in OA
description: Essential: Correct expression for tension in string OA, derived from vertical equilibrium at knot O.

title: Tension in OB
description: Essential: Correct expression for tension in string OB, derived from horizontal equilibrium at knot O.

title: Maximum friction force
description: Important: Correct calculation of maximum static friction force on object C, using given coefficient and normal force.

title: Equilibrium for object C
description: Important: Recognition that horizontal tension OB equals the friction force when object C is about to slide.

title: Maximum mass m1
description: Essential: Correct final numerical value for the maximum mass m1, with correct units.

title: Trigonometric application
description: Important: Correct use of given sine and cosine values (or tan) in force component resolutions.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Explicit unit analysis or inclusion of units in intermediate steps.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Incorrect sign in force balance (e.g., wrong direction for tension or friction).

title: Angle misuse
description: Pitfall: Confusing sine and cosine when resolving forces for the given angle.
